$comment: AI-ROADMAP Phase 2 — known-failing backend tests (whole of src/, widened from the AI modules in §205). Generated by `npm run test:ai-known-failures:update`. Entries may only be REMOVED (by fixing the test); adding one is a deliberate act that needs a reason and a ticket.

reasons.assertion_mismatch: The code and the test disagree about expected behaviour. Each needs a product decision (is the test stale, or did the behaviour regress?) — not a mechanical fix. Triage per e2e-bug.351.
reasons.mock_shape_undefined: Spec constructs a service with an incomplete mock; a collaborator the code calls is undefined. Mechanical to fix — extend the mock. Not a product bug. — CLEARED in §194/§196: the class is gone, kept for history.
reasons.mock_missing_transaction: Spec's repository/manager mock has no `transaction`, so any code path opening one throws. Same class as mock_shape_undefined and the largest single cluster (7 suites, 48 tests) — likely one shared test helper fixes all of them. — CLEARED in §197/§200/§202: the class is gone, kept for history.
reasons.tour_slot_seeding: public-booking tour day-level slot assertions (e2e-bug.471). The suites now load and their repos answer, but the assertions need seeded slot rows the harness never staged. Fabricating slots would turn the assertion green while testing nothing — the boundary drawn in §194/§197.
reasons.prepayment_mode_contradiction: e2e-bug.475 — booking-payment.tour expects prepaymentAmount 340/85 while its own fixture declares prepaymentMode: NONE, and production returns 0 via a !serviceIds.length short-circuit. Either tours must prepay in full regardless of mode (production bug) or NONE means zero (stale test). Needs a product answer; one option changes what customers are charged.
reasons.sample_slot_count_assertion: e2e273 / e2e318 — public-booking count assertions (toBeGreaterThan(0), toHaveLength(1)) that return empty. Genuine disagreements about scheduling behaviour, not fixture rot; tracked under e2e-bug.471 as the residue after 80 of 89 were fixed in §193-§204.
reasons.src/modules/ai/eval/ai-command-eval.inte: e2e-bug.456 (open product decision) — the golden-catalog case e2e137-professional-profile expects a dashboard rescue to explain_professional_profile, but that command is spec-ed [customer, public]. Blocked on whether dashboard gains the surface or the scenario is retired.
